page.layout: One page of text, one column. Running head at the top with the page number at the left. Paragraphs 14, 15 and 16, then the summary list, then the centred heading APPENDIX, an italic subtitle, and the numbered paragraph 1 running to the foot of the page. Catchword at the lower right. No marginal notes.

main_text.l: 14. Digne accedunt ad cœnam Domini, qui seipsos probant,

l.i: id est, vera fide & pœnitentia prædicti sunt. Hanc qui in se non
apprehendunt, nec sine ea debent accedere, ne iudicium sibi e-
dant & bibant, nec pœnitentiam cum qua accedant differre,
ne indurationem & pœnas æternas sibi attrahant.

main_text.l: 15. Admittere ad eam Ecclesiam debet omnes qui funda-

l.i: mentum doctrinæ Christianæ se amplecti & propositum huic
obediendi se habere profitentur: arcere autem eos, qui vel
ab erroribus, blasphemiis, vel a manifestis contra conscienti-
am peccatis admoniti ab Ecclesia, & erroris convicti, nolunt
desistere.

main_text.l: 16. Papa male ex ritu Cœnæ sustulit fractionem panis,

l.i: & usum poculi ademit populo: Male item tot additis cæremoniis,
de quibus Apostoli non præceperunt, cænam Domini in Mis-
sam theatricam, hoc est, in [illegible, ~9 letters] Iudaicam & histrionicas
præstigias deformauit. Sed magis impia & idololatrica figmen-
ta fint[?]. Missam esse sacrificium propitiatorium, in quo Chri-
stus a sacrificulis pro viuis & mortuis offeratur Patri: &
vi consecrationis substantialiter præsens sit & maneat tantisper
dum species illæ maneant incorruptæ, & gratiam Dei atque a-
lia beneficia conferat iis pro quibus offertur, & a
quibus ore corporis edatur, etiam sine bono ipsorum motu: atque etiam re-
positus & circumgestatus sub illis speciebus sit adorandus. Pro-
pter hæc tetra[?] necesse est Missam in Ecclesia Christiana abol-
eri. Sunt autem in summa. 1. Trassubstantiatio. 2. Ἀρτολατρία[?].
3. Sacrificium. 4. Mutilatio.
Synusiastarum præcipua quædam argumenta aduersus syn-
ceram de Cœna Domini doctrinam, & Sacramentarios,
quos vocant: Cum refutatione.

signa & symbola. Resp. Docemus res significatas unà
cum signis in usu legitimo exhibeti & communicari,
licet non corporaliter, sed eo modo qui Sacramentis
competit.2. Adesse Christum tantummodo secundum effica-

page.notes: Doubtful readings: the Greek word after "hoc est, in" is unreadable at this scan resolution. "figmenta fint" is uncertain: the final word is unclear. "tetra" after "Propter hæc" is doubtful. The Greek word "Ἀρτολατρία" is a best reading of a short Greek word and is marked as uncertain. The word "exhibeti" is printed that way and is left as printed. The paragraph "1." continues onto the next page (catchword "ciam."). No marginal notes on this page.
